annotations.title: Use or turn down a drafted fix

description: TrackerHacker drafts a fix when a hack stops matching (draftedFix in check_tracks), and waits for the person in To do. When the person asks you to: use it (after test_hack on read_inbox's messages from its senders shows it reads them), then rerun_inbox; or turn it down, keeping the hack as it is.

use.description: true uses it, false turns it down.
